Raw value of what?  If you want the raw data that are generated from the population you specify, you can get that using the generate() function in simsem.
I can not find where I can find out 'data' slot in the sim() object.

There is no "data" slot in the output of sim()

class?SimResult

Are you talking about the "Data" slot in a lavaan object?

class?lavaan

If you want access to the lavaan object, you can write a custom function (e.g., "getLavaanObject") and use the argument sim(..., outfun = getLavaanObject).  Then it will be saved in the "extraOut" slot of the SimResult object, and you can access it using the getExtraOutput() function. 

## this will return the lavaan object
getLavaanObject <- function(x) return(x)

I really want to get equivalent this information ASAP.
  • lavaan::lavInspect(x, "cov.ov")
  • lavaan::lavInspect(x, "mean.ov")
  • data slot values of lavaan object

If you know ahead of time the information you want from the lavaan object, then you can write your custom function to get that instead of the entire lavaan object.

getMoreStuff <- function(x) {
  output <- list()
  output$cov.ov <- lavaan::lavInspect(x, "cov.ov")
  output$mean.ov <- lavaan::lavInspect(x, "mean.ov")
  ## anything else you want to add to the output list
  return(output)
}
